remarks: Welcome to 109 Troy View! Tucked away on a desirable cul-de-sac in Williamsville, this stunning 5-bedroom, 3 full and 3 half bath home offers almost 3,400 sq. ft. of beautifully appointed living space. From the moment you step inside, you'll appreciate the thoughtful design, quality craftsmanship, and exceptional attention to detail throughout. The beautifully updated interior features a gorgeous custom kitchen complete with soft-close cabinetry, quartz countertops, stylish backsplash, and stainless steel appliances. The spacious and versatile floor plan boasts generously sized bedrooms, including TWO primary en-suites, one conveniently located on the first floor and another on the second, offering exceptional flexibility and comfort. A convenient first-floor laundry room and mudroom add to the home's everyday functionality. Tastefully updated bathrooms, beautiful hardwood flooring, and carefully selected finishes create a sophisticated yet inviting atmosphere throughout. Enjoy the comfort and peace of mind of updated mechanical systems, including a furnace, central air conditioning, and tankless hot water system, along with updated roofing, windows, and doors. The attached garage features a durable epoxy-coated floor, convenient floor drain, and water faucet, adding both practicality and a polished finish. Step outside to enjoy the covered concrete patio overlooking the backyard, offering an inviting space for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply relaxing. The finished basement provides additional space ideal for recreation or relaxation. With its expansive layout, spacious bedrooms, upscale finishes, and desirable cul-de-sac setting, 109 Troy View offers an exceptional combination of modern elegance, everyday comfort, and functionality. A truly remarkable home that must be experienced in person! Showings begin on 10/14 @4pm.
